arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Heintz argued that Congress passed a waiver statute to protect workers on federal projects.
Mr. Stewart argued that the case is not moot despite recent state legislative changes.
Justice Kagan questioned the strength of non-textual arguments presented by the government.
Chief Justice Roberts asked whether state workers' compensation laws would apply to state-owned facilities.
